commit_message: Add exact single-model benchmark runtime mode
pr_title: GameEngine: add reproducible local LLM benchmark experiments
pr_body:
## Summary

Builds a reproducible GameEngine Agent Benchmark runner for arbitrary discovered/exact local models. The experiment path freezes model/task/repeat policy and repository fixture identity, resets each run from a repository-owned fixture, and now provides a strict single-model NativeAgentRuntime mode that bypasses ADR0150 specialist routing and fallback so attribution cannot be contaminated.

Further commits on this Draft PR wire child-Editor scenario execution and AI Studio suite controls for all seven ADR0142 tasks.
